violated_contract: A gate that reasons about what a PR changed must compute that set as the three-dot diff against the PR's live base (merge-base versus HEAD). GitHub's pull_request merge ref has BASE as first parent, so walking first-parent or diffing HEAD~ describes the base instead of the PR; the same walk on a local merge describes the incoming base-side files and can drop the PR's own files entirely.
canonical_prevention: Diff merge-base(<live-base>, HEAD) versus HEAD (three-dot <live-base>...HEAD). Never rewrite that to first-parent, never use HEAD~. Commit subjects are `git log --no-merges <merge-base>..<head>`. The reusable guard is the parent-order invariance tests, which assert the same files and subjects on the branch head and on a --no-ff merge in both parent orders: scripts/test-changed-files.sh, FailureClassCliTests.test_validate_agrees_on_branch_head_and_both_merge_parent_orders, SelectionTests.test_changed_files_agrees_on_branch_head_and_both_merge_parent_orders, ThreeDotChangeSetTests.test_load_changed_paths_agrees_on_both_merge_parent_orders.
